title: ＴＯＥＩＣ　中級
subtitle: TOEIC Intermediate
educationalGoal: This class is for students who started from English Topics 5 (intermediate class) or for students who want to further improve their TOIEC scores for job hunting or going to graduate school. Students will learn the test taking techniques nessesary to improve each part of the TOEIC test. Students will learn skills for listening, grammar, and reading comprehention.
advice:
Students will have to attend every class from Monday to Friday. They must have the motivation to give all their time and effort to improve their TOEIC scores during the 3 intensive weeks of study.

Students will have to take the pre- and post-course IP tests.

Students are strongly encouraged to take the official TOEIC test right after finishing this course.

This class is dedicated to improving the TOEIC scores by learning test-taking strategies for listening, grammar, and reading comprehension. This class does not focus on communicative skills or grammar. Students must improve those skills on their own during this course.

Active learning includes presentations, Q & A, pair work, and group work.
books:
TOEIC L&R Test Derutan Tokkyu Gin no Phrase (Tex Kato, Asahi Shimbun Publications, 9784023316843)
TOEIC(R) L&R Test Kyukyoku no Moshi 600+ (Hiro Maeda, ALC Press,9784757433960)
requiredKnowledge: This class will be conducted with the understanding that students already have basic English skills. This course will be for students who started from English Topics 5 (intermediate class).
